Jakub Novak’s ability to bridge complex technical challenges with tangible business outcomes has been a cornerstone of our team’s success at EcoCart. Last quarter, he spearheaded a project to streamline our inventory synchronization system, which reduced order fulfillment delays by 25% while maintaining zero downtime. His approach—combining deep systems thinking with a knack for simplifying workflows—allowed us to scale efficiently without compromising reliability. This isn’t just technical acumen; it’s a reflection of his methodical mindset and commitment to measurable impact.  

As a skip-level manager, I’ve interacted with Jakub primarily through cross-functional initiatives. His rare blend of technical insight and strategic patience makes him an invaluable collaborator. When our marketing team needed real-time analytics integration, he translated their vague requirements into a robust, scalable solution, earning praise for his clarity and responsiveness. His ability to align technical execution with business priorities is uncommon.  

Jakub’s strengths lie in his capacity to decompose intricate problems into manageable components and his relentless attention to operational excellence. He’s also a mentor who fosters growth without micromanaging, which has elevated the performance of junior engineers. His work ethic is unshakable—whether debugging late nights or refining processes during off-hours, he prioritizes outcomes over recognition.  

In summary, Jakub is a rare combination of technical precision and collaborative leadership. His contributions have directly influenced our ability to meet evolving customer demands. I’m confident he’ll bring the same rigor and innovation to any new opportunity.  

Sincerely,  
[Recommender’s Name]  
Senior Director of Engineering, EcoCart Technologies
